description: Compared with older white men, older Mexican American men with high English proficiency are four times less likely to receive depression treatment, and those with low English proficiency ten times less likely. Latino men with low English proficiency had 2.5 times the likelihood of unmet mental health need compared with Latina women.
energy_note: Ten times less likely, for not speaking English.

aspect: EXAMPLE - stigma predicts dropping out of care
description: Vega et al. (2010) found Latino men experiencing greater stigma were less likely to manage depressive symptoms or take medication, and missed more treatment appointments.
energy_note: The shame predicts the missed appointment.

aspect: Attending costs a shift he is paid by the hour for
description: Preventive care requires unpaid absence from hourly work, so the rational short-term choice is always to postpone.
energy_note: A check-up costs a day's pay and he is fine.
